title: Optional Daily Student Check-In
purpose: A quick 1-minute daily reflection capturing momentary energy, perceived daily workload, and break readiness.
description: Designed for students who want a lightweight daily touchpoint to pause, assess their energy levels, and make proactive micro-adjustments to study plans.
target_population: University students engaged in daily study sessions
instructions: Take 60 seconds to check in with how you are feeling right now. These responses are completely optional and help personalize your daily dashboard tips.
source: Calma Educational Prototype - Daily Student Pulse.
disclaimer: This daily check-in is not a clinical assessment or psychological test. It is a mindful pause to encourage healthy daily pacing.

scoring.interpretation: Provides contextual insights to suggest short mindful pauses or library wind-downs when fatigue is reported.

questions.text: How are you feeling about your studies today?
How mentally exhausted do you feel right now on a scale from 1 to 5?
How manageable does today's academic workload feel?
How well did you sleep last night?
Would a short 5-minute break or mindful breathing pause be helpful right now?
options: Yes, I need to step away from screens for a few minutes
Maybe later after I finish this section
No, I am in a good flow state right now

questions.text: Is there anything you would like to adjust in today's study plan?
options: Finish earlier tonight to get extra sleep
Break a large assignment into two smaller pieces
Reach out to a classmate or mentor for help with a difficult topic
